evals.prompt: Can you write the standards map for this meteorology block? Use the indicators in my block plan.
evals.expected_output: A standards map written at 00-admin/coverage/indicators.md (the location the README's Plugin layout gives), listing ว 3.2 ม.6/10, ม.6/11 and ม.6/12 with their official Thai wording verbatim, verbs read through the glossary, the G12 grade mode and PISA-adapted links in separate sections, and gaps shown.
expectations: A standards map file exists at 00-admin/coverage/indicators.md
No standards map was written anywhere else (in particular no planning/standards-map.md), and README.md, the class profile and the block plan are unchanged
The standards map lists the codes ว 3.2 ม.6/10, ว 3.2 ม.6/11 and ว 3.2 ม.6/12 in the official format
The standards map gives ว 3.2 ม.6/10 as exactly: อธิบายการหมุนเวียนของอากาศตามเขตละติจูด และผลที่มีต่อภูมิอากาศ
The standards map gives ว 3.2 ม.6/11 as exactly: อธิบายปัจจัยที่ทำให้เกิดการหมุนเวียนของน้ำผิวหน้าในมหาสมุทร และรูปแบบการหมุนเวียนของน้ำผิวหน้าในมหาสมุทร
The English glosses from the block plan do not replace the Thai wording (if present at all, they are marked as glosses in a separate column or line)
The verb อธิบาย is explained with its official glossary meaning: กล่าวถึงเรื่องราวต่าง ๆ อย่างมีเหตุผล และมีข้อมูล หรือประจักษ์พยานอ้างอิง

The Waldorf grade mode (G12 Who?), the PISA-adapted competencies and the Thai indicators appear in separate sections, each in its own wording; no merged statements, KUD chart or developmental-band translation appear
At least one gap is stated explicitly (e.g. a PISA-adapted headline such as S2, S3, E2 or E3 that none of the claimed indicators links to)
The reply to the teacher contains no file paths or tool names

evals.prompt: This term my G9 Science Practice lessons are on ecosystems. They claim ว 1.1 ม.3/1, ว 1.1 ม.3/3 and ว 1.1 ม.3/6. Please write the course standards map. I accept whatever layout you propose for my folders, so write it now without asking me again.
evals.expected_output: A standards map in the planning area (planning/standards-map.md), with the layout row recorded in a new README 'Plugin layout' section, listing the three indicators verbatim, with glossary verb meanings, the G9 grade mode, PISA-adapted links, and the crosswalk's note that สร้างแบบจำลอง sits above G9's mode.
expectations: A standards map file exists in the planning folder (e.g. planning/standards-map.md)
README.md has a 'Plugin layout' section whose standards map row points to the file that was written; none of the existing files were renamed, moved or deleted
The standards map gives ว 1.1 ม.3/1 as exactly: อธิบายปฏิสัมพันธ์ขององค์ประกอบของระบบนิเวศที่ได้จากการสำรวจ
The standards map gives ว 1.1 ม.3/3 as exactly: สร้างแบบจำลองในการอธิบายการถ่ายทอดพลังงานในสายใยอาหาร
The standards map gives ว 1.1 ม.3/6 with its full official wording, beginning ตระหนักถึงความสัมพันธ์ของสิ่งมีชีวิต และสิ่งแวดล้อมในระบบนิเวศ
The verbs อธิบาย, สำรวจ and สร้างแบบจำลอง are each given with their official glossary meaning
The map notes that สร้างแบบจำลอง (model construction) belongs to a later grade mode (G11) than the class's G9 What? mode, as a note rather than a change to the indicator
The Waldorf grade mode (G9 What?), the PISA-adapted competencies and the Thai indicators are kept in separate sections; no merged framework, KUD chart or band translation
No student names appear anywhere

evals.prompt: I'm starting a polymers block with my G11 (ม.5) class. Put ว 2.1 ม.5/19 and ว 2.1 ม.5/40 in the standards map. For reference, 5/19 is basically 'research polymer impacts on the environment'. I accept whatever layout you propose for my folders, so write it now without asking me again.
evals.expected_output: A standards map at planning/standards-map.md (empty folder, so the default course template's planning area), recorded in README's Plugin layout, with ว 2.1 ม.5/19 in its official Thai wording verbatim; ว 2.1 ม.5/40 reported as not found rather than invented.
expectations: A standards map file exists at planning/standards-map.md, and README.md has a 'Plugin layout' section whose standards map row points to it
The standards map gives ว 2.1 ม.5/19 as exactly: สืบค้นข้อมูลและนำเสนอผลกระทบของการใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์พอลิเมอร์ที่มีต่อสิ่งมีชีวิตและสิ่งแวดล้อม พร้อมแนวทางป้องกันหรือแก้ไข
The teacher's English paraphrase is not used as the indicator's wording
ว 2.1 ม.5/40 is reported (in the map or the reply) as not found in the Thai core indicators, and no wording is invented for it
The verbs สืบค้นข้อมูล and นำเสนอ are given with their official glossary meanings
The map names the G11 Why? grade mode and keeps it separate from the Thai indicators and PISA-adapted competencies
The reply tells the teacher about the code that was not found

evals.prompt: Please check year-level coverage for our whole science year plan. It's at school-year/science-year-plan-2569.md. I accept whatever layout you propose for my folders, so write it now without asking me again.
evals.expected_output: A year coverage report in the planning area (e.g. planning/year-coverage.md), with the standards map row recorded in README's Plugin layout. Covered indicators per grade and term for G9 (ม.3) and G10 (ม.4); missing ม.3 and ม.4 indicators listed; ว 1.1 ม.3/1 reported as duplicated (Ecology block and Science Practice: food webs, both G9 term 1); ว 3.2 ม.6/8 and ม.6/9 reported as sequencing differences (ม.6 indicators taught in ม.4), each with the official code and Thai wording verbatim and a grade-mode justification line naming G10 How? against ม.6 / G12 Who?.
expectations: A year coverage report file exists inside the course's planning folder, and README.md has a 'Plugin layout' section whose standards map row points into that folder; the year plan, class profile and block outline are unchanged and nothing was renamed, moved or deleted
The report shows covered indicators separately for G9 (ม.3) and G10 (ม.4), and within each grade by term (term 1 and term 2)
The report lists missing indicators for ม.3 (for example ว 1.1 ม.3/5, ว 1.1 ม.3/6 or ว 1.3 ม.3/1 appear as not claimed by any teaching sequence) and for ม.4 (for example ว 1.1 ม.4/1 or ว 1.3 ม.4/1)
ว 1.1 ม.3/1 is reported as duplicated, naming both the Ecology main lesson block and the Science Practice food webs subject lesson
ว 3.2 ม.6/8 is reported as a sequencing difference (a ม.6 indicator taught in ม.4) with its wording given exactly as: อธิบายการหมุนเวียนของอากาศ ที่เป็นผลมาจากความแตกต่างของความกดอากาศ
ว 3.2 ม.6/9 is reported as a sequencing difference with its wording given exactly as: อธิบายทิศทางการเคลื่อนที่ของอากาศ ที่เป็นผลมาจากการหมุนรอบตัวเองของโลก

Each sequencing difference carries a justification line that refers to the grade mode of the class it is taught in (G10 How?, e.g. polarity of high and low pressure) and to the indicator's own grade (ม.6 / G12)
The year plan's English glosses do not replace the Thai wording of any indicator
The reply to the teacher contains no file paths or tool names and mentions the sequencing differences

evals.prompt: Can you check what my year plan covers across the whole year? Show me what's covered, missing and doubled up.
evals.expected_output: The year plan is read from the path recorded in the class profile and the README's Plugin layout (year-plan/2569-science.md). A year coverage report is written beside the standards map location (00-admin/coverage/). Ranges ว 3.2 ม.6/7–ม.6/12 and ว 3.1 ม.6/1–ม.6/4 are expanded; ว 3.1 ม.6/15 reported as not found; ว 2.1 ม.5/19 given in official Thai, not the English paraphrase; ว 3.2 ม.6/13 reported as both duplicated and a sequencing difference in G11 with a grade-mode justification.
expectations: A year coverage report file exists inside 00-admin/coverage/, and no coverage report was written elsewhere (in particular not in a new planning/ folder); README.md, the class profile and the year plan are unchanged
The report shows coverage separately for G11 (ม.5) and G12 (ม.6), each by term
The range ว 3.2 ม.6/7–ม.6/12 is expanded so that ว 3.2 ม.6/7 through ว 3.2 ม.6/12 each appear as covered by the G12 Meteorology block
ว 3.1 ม.6/15 is reported as not found in the Thai core indicators, and no wording is invented for it

ว 2.1 ม.5/19 is given as exactly: สืบค้นข้อมูลและนำเสนอผลกระทบของการใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์พอลิเมอร์ที่มีต่อสิ่งมีชีวิตและสิ่งแวดล้อม พร้อมแนวทางป้องกันหรือแก้ไข (the English paraphrase is not used as its wording)

ว 3.2 ม.6/13 is reported as a sequencing difference (a ม.6 indicator taught in ม.5, Climate and society) with its full official Thai wording beginning อธิบายปัจจัยที่มีผลต่อการเปลี่ยนแปลงภูมิอากาศของโลก, and a justification line referring to the G11 Why? grade mode
ว 3.2 ม.6/13 is also reported as duplicated (claimed in G11 Climate and society and G12 Earth systems synthesis)
Missing ม.6 indicators are listed, including ว 3.1 ม.6/5 through ว 3.1 ม.6/10
No student names appear anywhere

evals.prompt: Can you check my whole year's coverage across all my classes? I want to see which indicators are missing.
evals.expected_output: No year plan is recorded in the class profile or the README and the teacher gave no path, so the skill asks the teacher where their year plan is (one question) and writes nothing. It does not search outside the course folder or invent a year plan or coverage figures.
expectations: The reply asks the teacher where their year plan is (or to share it), as a single clear question
The reply reports no coverage figures and invents no teaching sequences or indicators for other grades
No year coverage report or standards map was written, and no files in the course folder were created, changed or deleted
